labels.label: requested
labels.why: The request says "The agent a ticket is assigned to is notified that it was assigned to them"; using the outbox and a template only decides how that notification is sent.

labels.why: "Every ticket shows its `assignee` (null when unassigned)" fails unless the field is stored, and "Everything the service already does keeps working" requires the existing audit to keep working.

labels.label: implied

labels.label: requested
labels.why: The request says "an agent is a non-empty name of at most 64 characters"; the row enforces that rule and keeps the existing HTTP boundaries, adding no new access control.
